message: 魔族さん、いらっしゃい

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, I don't think calling out like that will actually make them come out...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I know that! But sitting around doing nothing and fidgeting isn't good either!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The path of justice begins with a single step. I'll do whatever it takes for peace!」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's usually so irresponsible and just plays around, but she's surprisingly sensible.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Didn't say a thing.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, I want to transform so badly!」

name: Synn
message: 「If you want to transform, I think you should just do it...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you talking about?! There's a proper order to things. Without necessity, there is zero reason to transform!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Without a reason, I cannot transform. As they say, that would be getting blown smoke where there's no fire!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I don't even know where to begin calling you out on that...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Do you really wanna see this angel naked that badly?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What should I do? It's so troubling.」
A refreshing singing voice approaches from a distance.

name: Synn
message: 「That voice sounds like the mineral water Nanaka shared with me a long time ago...」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious! Though tap water is fine enough for me.」
We pass by the owner of the voice.

name: Lolotte
message: 「She's the president of the Yodel Club.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, I took part in their trial club session.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! You'll never know what's fun until you try it. If you throw enough at the wall, something's bound to stick!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're just a bundle of curiosity, aren't you?」

name: Paqy
message: 「So if it's the Yodel Club, then--」

name: Synn
message: 「Can you sing that yodel stuff, Lolotte?」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's yodeling. That's amazing, Lolotte! I don't really know much about it, but you sound like a total pro.」
